cds.title: Marshall University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; page headers still print 2024-2025, data are Fall 2025)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025). International: 93 applied, 91 admitted, 16 enrolled (residency table). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column. No early decision or early action; no waitlist. SAT composite percentiles 940/1040/1140 are also published; the composite is not a test type shown here. The Common Data Set file's page headers say 2024-2025 but the cohort and dates refer to Fall 2025. The admission-factor checkboxes could not be read reliably from the text, so no factors are shown.

cds_test_policy.notes: The Common Data Set says SAT/ACT are used in admission decisions (which box is ticked cannot be read from the text); the university catalog states test scores are not required for admission.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (first-year, 2026-27): in-state tuition $7,770, out-of-state/nonresident $18,772, required fees $1,618, food and housing $13,826. Tuition varies by program (86.5% pay more than the listed first-year tuition). Only the college's own non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 48 nonresidents received it (average $23,681)
